integrity: All exact finite checks are diagnostics, not infinite proof; references and assumptions explicit.
scientific_limitations: Existence of infinitely many prime witnesses, not all primes or a prime density. Existing lacunarity theorem already gives zero density of the sharpness set and is not claimed as novel. Analytic Hecke theorem is an external established input; independent audit not performed.
title: Infinitely many prime-index sharp ternary valuations for tagged odd-part partitions
